notes: Large-source-unit check: מִלְמַעְלָה → above. מִן and לְ compound with the adverb מַעַל and its directive he into one fixed expression rendered by a single English word; no English word is spent on any morpheme apart from the others, so all four share the unit under rules 30 and 32, headed on מַעַל, which carries the lexeme. Retained as genuinely indivisible.

Periphrastic וַיִּהְיוּ … פֹּרְשִׂים rendered by the single finite spread forth; הָיָה is unrepresented, since the subject stands between it and the participle and rule 30's contiguity condition is unmet. Competing reading fuses s002 with s005.
